summary: Export unread mailbox counts and oldest unread ages for locally owned managed agents

replay.detail: Telemetry only; no claim replay changes.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: Message delivery, read, close and silent-message rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds st.mailbox.unread u64 and st.mailbox.oldest_unread_age f64 observable gauges on meter st3, with full declared st.agent and pending, delivered or held st.mailbox.state attributes. Age uses seconds, matching st.fifo.oldest_age. Empty states emit zeros; incomplete coordination bootstrap omits only held. Host identity remains resource host.name, not a point attribute. Only managed locally owned agents are exported, excluding people and remote owners.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; no new backfill.

manual.detail: Existing OTLP metrics configuration exports the new instruments. Cached summaries refresh without overlap with a minimum 30-second pause; collection performs no store reads.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback removes the new telemetry without changing durable state.
